rule: DR-0014 (proposed; row 10 stays Open, nothing ratified)

record.conditions: Vin 3.30 V, 1 mA, Cout 1 uF, ESR 0, Cc nominal; 45-point PVT grid; Middlebrook loop gain T = (Tv*Ti - 1)/(Tv + Ti + 2) reconstructed from the two-injection benches tb_loopgain2v/tb_loopgain2i by loopgain2.py (issue #135), resolved prefix only

cross_checks: every trace reproduces its record's 0 dB crossing count, first-crossing PM, recorded worst-crossing PM and first -180 deg GM; every recorded PM/GM miss classifies as fail (no-loosening guard)

subset.name: multi_crossing_points
subset.definition: points the record lists with more than one 0 dB crossing (reported ambiguous by the characterization report before DR-0014)

not_claimed: no new simulation; no historical record edited
no ratification: DR-0014 is proposed and row 10 stays Open (DR-0007)
no claim about frequencies above the sweep ceiling or between sampled operating points
method: two-injection Middlebrook loop gain (loopgain2.py), resolved prefix only; classification rules unchanged (DR-0014, proposed; row 10 stays Open)

resolution_overlay.rule: a point whose reconstruction is truncated below the sweep ceiling is reported ambiguous (pass -> ambiguous; fail unchanged); its GM above-ceiling bound is withdrawn and its Nyquist bookkeeping is undetermined. The ceiling columns describe the END OF THE RESOLVED PREFIX, not the 10 GHz sweep ceiling.
